appearance.depiction: Adult woman; exact age is unknown.
appearance.hair: Long auburn-brown hair, partly braided and worn loose around the face.
appearance.clothing: Layered, worn travel clothes in muted cream, blue-gray, and brown, with an olive-green hooded cloak and blue-gray scarf.
appearance.vibe: Charming and approachable, with a quietly observant quality.

manner: Buxom and charming; asks travellers about their pasts, plans, and families.
